letter.welcome.title: Welcome!
letter.welcome.text: You are signed up. Take a moment to write your letter to Santa: your message, then a few gift ideas.
letter.write.heading: Dear Santa…
letter.write.intro_hint: Your Santa will read it without knowing it is you. You will not be unmasked.
letter.write.intro_error: Your message is too long or contains invalid characters. Shorten it and try again.
letter.ideas.heading: My ideas
letter.ideas.empty: Your letter is still blank. Write at least a word for Santa.
letter.idea.error: Check the title (required), the link (http:// or https://) and the photo (JPEG, PNG or GIF, 2 MB at most).
letter.idea.max: A letter holds at most 5 ideas: delete one before adding another.
letter.notice.grouped: When you add several ideas in a row, your Santa only receives one email, 10 minutes after the last one.
letter.foot: You can edit your letter until the big day.
letter.error.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
letter.recue.empty: This letter is still blank: {name} has not written yet.
letter.recue.tabs_hint: No letter shows who reads yours.
letter.recue.silent: Santa does not reply, but reads everything.
letter.recue.silent_detail: You cannot write to {name}: they must stay surprised. They will only see that their letter was read.
